description: One QYSMART-COMFY yarn/material candidate from Qingdao Qi Yuan New Material Technology Co.,Ltd., based on the user-provided exhibition swatch card and the user's supplier explanation at the exhibition. The visible card shows QYSMARTCOMFY07, 40s/1 base yarn, 80% Viscose / 10% Polyester / 10% QYSMART-COMFY functional fiber, with the fabric composed of 95% base yarn + 20D PU 5%, 155 cm, 141 gsm, and claims of moisture regulation, moisture-absorption heat generation, and deodorization. The Japanese card calls the functional component 'アクリレート', while the supplier explanation describes it as modified acrylic (改性腈纶); this naming discrepancy must remain under Human Review. Supplier explanation: the conventional design would use three dye baths, but this sample uses two baths because the modified-acrylic functional component did not dye and was left white, producing a mélange/heather effect. The user evaluates the resulting appearance as wool-like. Exact dyestuffs, bath sequence, polymer classification for Japanese legal labeling, spinning system, and commercial yarn specification remain unconfirmed.

Exact dyestuffs, bath sequence, temperatures and pH are unconfirmed.
